record.field:
IPA Wipe Down
IPA Semi Grade 100%
Wipes Texwipe 1010
Carefully pour IPA onto a new woven Texwipe 1010 and saturate the wipe. The Semi Grade IPA can also be dispensed into a IPA new squirt bottle.
Wipe the ceramic arm (3) plastic tabs first using the 100% IPA saturated Texwipe 1010. Discard the wipe.
Obtain another new Texwipe 1010 and saturate it with 100% IPA.
Wipe the top ceramic arm top ceramic surface using using the 100% IPA saturated Texwipe 1010. Wipe also the sides of the ceramic wafer arm.
Discard the wipe.
Place the wafer arm upside down with the (3) tabs pointing down on an untouched clean area of your 24" x 24" cleanroom plastic bag.
Don a new set of clean room gloves. Saturate another new Texwipe 1010 with 100% IPA and wipe the ceramic arm back side. Discard the Texwipe.
Grasp and hold the Wafer Arm and using the 100% IPA squirt bottle, apply 100% IPA to wash off the (3) plastic corner areas of the plastic rectangular tabs- where the Texwipe may not of reached or wiped.
Proceed directly to N2 blow off.
